meaning: Derives the existing conclusion of the quarta via argument through a population-relative form of the degree fork's split instead of through STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING. The maximum principle is applied at truth and at esse; actuality only insofar as being is applied at truth. Maximality is the weak IsMaximumIn. This is a formal alternative, not a reading of the source's order of argument. Every premise remains open.
